sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加州的一处葡萄园里发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血也被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来凶手费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是 Casefile Presents 推出的全新系列节目，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: On Friday, February 11, 2000, Mike Cassaday cut his workday short to make a difficult drive.
sentences.zh: 2000年2月11日，星期五，迈克·卡萨迪提前结束了工作，驱车前往一个艰难的目的地。

sentences.en: He had just received the devastating news that his younger brother, 39-year-old Jerry Cassaday, had been found dead at his home in Odessa, Missouri.
sentences.zh: 他刚刚接到一个令人痛心的消息，他39岁的弟弟杰瑞·卡萨迪被发现死在密苏里州敖德萨的家中。

sentences.en: Mike arrived at Jerry's apartment just as a sheriff's deputy and a funeral home director were preparing to remove his brother's body from the residence.
sentences.zh: 迈克赶到杰瑞的公寓时，一名治安官副警长和一家殡仪馆馆长正准备将他弟弟的遗体从住所运走。

sentences.en: Jerry, who lived alone, had been discovered by a concerned neighbour, slumped in a chair with a self-inflicted gunshot wound to the head.
sentences.zh: 独居的杰瑞是一位热心的邻居发现的，他瘫坐在椅子上，头部有自己开枪造成的枪伤。

sentences.en: Mike knew that his brother had been struggling lately with his mental health, mounting bills and a recent divorce, but he never imagined things would end this way.
sentences.zh: 迈克知道弟弟最近一直在跟心理健康问题、不断增加的账单以及刚发生的离婚做斗争，但他从未想过事情会以这种方式结束。

sentences.en: After a brief conversation with the officials, he entered Jerry's apartment.
sentences.zh: 在与官员们简短交谈后，他走进了杰瑞的公寓。

sentences.en: The reddish-brown plush recliner which normally sat in front of the television in the corner had been moved to face a trio of windows overlooking a nearby lake.
sentences.zh: 原本放在角落电视机前的红褐色毛绒躺椅，已经被移到了正对一排窗户的位置，窗外可以俯瞰附近的一个湖泊。

sentences.en: It was there, in that chair, that Jerry had taken his life with his .22-caliber rifle.
sentences.zh: 就是在那里，在那把椅子上，杰瑞用他的点二二口径步枪结束了自己的生命。

sentences.en: A row of framed family photos lined at the windowsill in front of him, and a Bible on his lap was open on the Gospel of Matthew.
sentences.zh: 他正前方的窗台上摆着一排镶框的家庭照片，他腿上放着一本翻开到《马太福音》的圣经。

sentences.en: 48-year-old Bruce Miller was not known for his punctuality, so when he failed to arrive home on time on the evening of Monday, November 8, 1999,
sentences.zh: 48岁的布鲁斯·米勒一向不守时，所以在1999年11月8日星期一的晚上，他没有按时回家时，

sentences.en: it was easy to assume he was just running late as usual.
sentences.zh: 人们很容易认为他只是像往常一样晚归了。

sentences.en: But his wife, Cherie, felt differently.
sentences.zh: 但他的妻子雪莉却有不同的感觉。

sentences.en: She had ordered takeout for the family, and Bruce was supposed to pick it up on his way home from work at B&D Auto Salvage, a scrapyard in his hometown of Flint, Michigan,
sentences.zh: 她为家人订了外卖，布鲁斯本应在下班回家的路上顺便去取，他的工作地点是家乡密歇根州弗林特市的一家废品收购站——B&D汽车回收公司，

sentences.en: that he owned and operated.
sentences.zh: 那是由他拥有并经营的。

sentences.en: Cherie had last spoken to Bruce shortly after 6pm as he was preparing to close up shop.
sentences.zh: 雪莉最后一次与布鲁斯通话是在傍晚6点刚过，当时他正准备关门打烊。

sentences.en: She had called to let him know their food was ready to be picked up, and as they chatted casually, Bruce mentioned a truck had just pulled up right outside his office.
sentences.zh: 她打电话来是告诉他饭已经做好了可以去取，在他们闲聊时，布鲁斯提到有一辆卡车刚刚停在他的办公室外面。

sentences.en: Assuming it was a late customer, he told Cherie he'd try to hurry them along.
sentences.zh: 他以为是有晚来的客户，便告诉雪莉他会尽量快点把他们打发走。

sentences.en: The last thing she'd heard was the sound of Bruce's office door opening as someone stepped inside.
sentences.zh: 她听到的最后一件事是布鲁斯办公室门打开的声音，有人走了进来。

sentences.en: When time continued to pass without any word from Bruce to explain his delay, Cherie phoned his office, but there was no answer.
sentences.zh: 时间一分一秒过去，布鲁斯却迟迟没有打电话解释他为什么耽搁了，雪莉便打了个电话到他的办公室，但没有人接。

sentences.en: When there was still no word from him by 8pm, Cherie phoned again.
sentences.zh: 到了晚上8点仍然没有他的消息，雪莉又打了一通电话。

sentences.en: Still nothing.
sentences.zh: 依然毫无音讯。

sentences.en: She reached out to several of Bruce's relatives, but given his notorious habit of running late, they weren't overly concerned.
sentences.zh: 她联系了布鲁斯的好几位亲戚，但鉴于他一向爱迟到的习惯，他们并没有过分担心。

sentences.en: Bruce's brother, Chuck, had spoken with him at around 5pm and said everything seemed perfectly normal.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯的弟弟查克在大约下午5点时跟他通过话，说一切看起来都非常正常。

sentences.en: It also wasn't unusual for customers to show up at the scrapyard right before closing time with last-minute business.
sentences.zh: 客户在临近关门前才赶到废品收购站谈最后一分钟的业务也是常有的事。

sentences.en: Unable to shake her concern, Cherie took Chuck's advice and drove to B&D Auto to check on her husband, bringing one of her sons along for the ride.
sentences.zh: 雪莉怎么也挥之不去心中的担忧，便听从了查克的建议，带着她的一个儿子开车去B&D汽车回收公司查看丈夫的情况。

sentences.en: On the way, she stopped at the restaurant where they had ordered dinner.
sentences.zh: 在路上，她顺便去了他们订晚餐的那家餐厅。

sentences.en: Staff there confirmed that Bruce hadn't come to pick it up.
sentences.zh: 那里的员工证实布鲁斯并没有去取餐。

sentences.en: Cherie then followed the route Bruce typically took home in case his truck had broken down along the way, but there was no sign of him.
sentences.zh: 接着，雪莉沿着布鲁斯通常回家的路线寻找，以防他的卡车在半路抛锚，但一路上连他的影子也没看到。

sentences.en: When she finally reached the scrapyard, the front gate was closed, indicating Bruce had left for the day.
sentences.zh: 等她终于到达废品收购站时，前门是关着的，这表明布鲁斯已经离开回家了。

sentences.en: Cherie retraced the drive from the yard back to the restaurant, then home, but still didn't encounter Bruce or his car.
sentences.zh: 雪莉沿原路从收购站返回餐厅，然后再开回家，但一路上仍然没有遇到布鲁斯或他的车。

sentences.en: Panicking, she contacted the local and state police, who confirmed there had been no reported accidents involving her husband.
sentences.zh: 她惊慌失措地联系了当地和州警方，警方证实没有接到涉及她丈夫的交通事故报告。

sentences.en: She called hospitals, friends, and even Bruce's mother, but no one had seen or heard from him.
sentences.zh: 她打电话给医院、朋友，甚至布鲁斯的母亲，但没有人见过他或听过他的消息。

sentences.en: At last, Bruce's brother, Chuck, agreed to head to B&D Auto himself, thinking perhaps Bruce had been injured on the job and was unable to reach a phone.
sentences.zh: 最后，布鲁斯的弟弟查克同意自己前往B&D汽车回收公司，心想也许布鲁斯在工作中受了伤，无法触及电话。

sentences.en: Chuck arrived at the dark, isolated property and let himself in.
sentences.zh: 查克抵达了昏暗、偏僻的产业园区并自己开了门。

sentences.en: He drove past the rows of gutted and totaled cars lining the 500-yard-long driveway to Bruce's small office building.
sentences.zh: 他开车驶过两旁排列着被掏空和撞毁车辆的五百码长的车道，来到了布鲁斯的小办公楼前。

sentences.en: His concern mounted at the side of Bruce's truck parked out front.
sentences.zh: 看到布鲁斯的卡车停在门外，他的担忧顿时加剧了。

sentences.en: The office was eerily quiet as Chuck pushed through the unlocked door.
sentences.zh: 当查克推开没有上锁的门时，办公室里死一般地寂静。

sentences.en: He found Bruce face down on the floor behind the front counter with a dark pool of blood around his head.
sentences.zh: 他发现布鲁斯面朝下倒在前台后面的地板上，头部周围有一滩暗红色的血迹。

sentences.en: Bruce's office appeared undisturbed, leading Chuck to believe his death had been a tragic accident.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯的办公室看起来没有被翻动的迹象，这让查克以为他的死是一场悲惨的意外。

sentences.en: Maybe he had leaned too far back in his rickety metal office chair and tipped over, or suffered a heart attack, collapsing and injuring his head.
sentences.zh: 也许是他那把摇摇晃晃的金属办公椅往后靠得太远而翻倒了，或者他突发心脏病，摔倒并伤到了头部。

sentences.en: But when police arrived, the grim reality became clear.
sentences.zh: 但当警察赶到时，残酷的现实变得清晰起来。

sentences.en: Bruce had been shot in the throat at close range with a shotgun.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯在近距离被一把猎枪击中了喉咙。

sentences.en: News of Bruce's murder sent shockwaves through Flint.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯被谋杀的消息在弗林特引发了强烈震动。

sentences.en: A lifelong resident, he was known as a hard-working, easy-going family man.
sentences.zh: 作为一名土生土长的居民，他一直是个工作勤奋、随和顾家的好男人。

sentences.en: In preparation for retiring from a three-decade career testing engines for an automotive manufacturing company,
sentences.zh: 为了准备从一家汽车制造公司长达三十年的发动机测试生涯中退休，

sentences.en: Bruce poured his spare time and energy into B&D Auto Salvage.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯将他所有的业余时间和精力都倾注在了B&D汽车回收公司上。

sentences.en: It was more a labour of love than necessity.
sentences.zh: 与其说是出于生计，不如说是出于热爱。

sentences.en: Tinkering with cars had been a hobby of his since childhood, making the scrapyard feel more like a personal playground than a job site.
sentences.zh: 从小到大，鼓捣汽车一直是他的爱好，这让废品收购站与其说是一个工作地点，倒不如说更像是个人的游乐场。

sentences.en: The site itself provided the perfect setting for a killer to strike unnoticed.
sentences.zh: 这个地方本身就为凶手悄无声息地行凶提供了完美的背景。

sentences.en: B&D Auto was situated on the remote outskirts of northern Flint, nestled between a gravel quarry and a stock car racetrack.
sentences.zh: B&D汽车回收公司坐落在弗林特市北部偏远的郊外，夹在一个碎石采石场和一个赛车场之间。

sentences.en: Acres of wrecked vehicles surrounded Bruce's office building, which featured a single window overlooking the dirt driveway.
sentences.zh: 无数报废的车辆包围着布鲁斯的办公楼，楼里有一扇可以俯瞰泥土车道的单扇窗户。

sentences.en: Bruce employed a small team, but none were present at the time of the shooting.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯雇佣了一个小团队，但在枪击发生时谁都不在现场。

sentences.en: The scrapyard typically attracted DIY mechanics in need of replacement parts or specialists hunting for valuable components to salvage.
sentences.zh: 这家废品收购站通常吸引的是需要更换零件的自助汽车修理工，或是寻找贵重组件进行回收的专业人士。

sentences.en: There had never been any serious trouble at the site.
sentences.zh: 这个地方以前从未发生过什么严重的麻烦。

sentences.en: Bruce was a quiet, laid-back man whose calm demeanour and a sense of humour didn't invite conflict.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯是一个安静、悠闲的人，他平静的 demeanor 和幽默感并不招惹冲突。

sentences.en: As a result, there was no clear suspect or motive, leaving police to speculate that the killing must have been random.
sentences.zh: 因此，现场没有明确的嫌疑人或动机，这让警方推测这起谋杀一定是一起随机作案。

sentences.en: Scrapyards often drew shady characters, and B&D Auto was no exception.
sentences.zh: 废品收购站经常吸引形迹可疑的人物，B&D汽车回收公司也不例外。

sentences.en: Perhaps Bruce had angered a customer who reacted violently.
sentences.zh: 也许布鲁斯激怒了一位反应极端的客户。

sentences.en: Robbery was another possibility.
sentences.zh: 抢劫是另一种可能。

sentences.en: Bruce's wallet was missing, along with the $2,000 he was known to carry in his front shirt pocket to make change for his customers.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯的钱包不见了，和他习惯放在前胸口袋里用来给客户找零的2000美元现金也不翼而飞。

sentences.en: The missing money took on greater significance when investigators spoke to Bruce's devastated wife, Cherie.
sentences.zh: 当调查人员与布鲁斯悲痛欲绝的妻子雪莉交谈时，这笔失踪的现金显得更加意义重大。

sentences.en: She revealed that one of Bruce's former employees, a man named John Hutchinson, owed him $2,000.
sentences.zh: 她透露，布鲁斯的一名前员工，一个名叫约翰·哈钦森的男人，欠他2000美元。

sentences.en: Interestingly, Hutchinson was a prime suspect in a long-running auto fraud investigation, and it was believed he had used Bruce's scrapyard to carry out his scam.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，哈钦森是一项长期汽车欺诈调查的主要嫌疑人，据信他曾利用布鲁斯的废品收购站来实施他的骗局。

sentences.en: In fact, fraud investigators had visited B&D Auto the day before Bruce's murder to speak with him about Hutchinson.
sentences.zh: 事实上，欺诈调查人员在布鲁斯遇害的前一天曾造访过B&D汽车回收公司，找他谈论关于哈钦森的事。

sentences.en: The conversation never happened as Bruce wasn't at work when they stopped by.
sentences.zh: 但他们顺道拜访时布鲁斯不在上班，所以谈话并未发生。

sentences.en: John Hutchinson's brother, Harold, also worked at the yard.
sentences.zh: 约翰·哈钦森的弟弟哈罗德也在该收购站工作。

sentences.en: Harold told the detectives that weeks earlier, his brother had confided in him that he was planning to kill Bruce in connection with the fraud case.
sentences.zh: 哈罗德告诉侦探们，几周前，他的哥哥曾向他吐露，他正计划因为这起欺诈案而杀死布鲁斯。

sentences.en: The morning after the shooting, Harold claimed his brother told him he had, quote,
sentences.zh: 枪击案发生的次日上午，哈罗德声称他哥哥对他说过，原话是：

sentences.en: It seemed plausible that Bruce had planned to report his rogue former employee to the police, giving Hutchinson a motive to kill him before he could talk.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯显然计划向警方举报他这个行径败坏的前员工，这给了哈钦森一个在布鲁斯开口前将其杀害的动机。

sentences.en: While Harold Hutchinson's claims supported this theory, investigators had to proceed with caution.
sentences.zh: 尽管哈罗德·哈钦森的说法支持了这一理论，但调查人员必须谨慎行事。

sentences.en: Harold had a mild intellectual disability and they suspected he was easily influenced, potentially saying what he thought they wanted to hear.
sentences.zh: 哈罗德有轻度的智力残疾，他们怀疑他很容易受人影响，可能会说出他认为警察想听的话。

sentences.en: He therefore wouldn't be considered a reliable witness in court.
sentences.zh: 因此，他在法庭上不能被视为一个可靠的证人。

sentences.en: Seeking more concrete evidence, detectives went to speak with John Hutchinson directly.
sentences.zh: 为了寻找更确凿的证据，侦探们直接去找约翰·哈钦森谈话。

sentences.en: Hutchinson appeared surprised when police arrived at his home to question him and conduct a search.
sentences.zh: 当警察来到他家对他进行盘问和搜查时，哈钦森显得很吃惊。

sentences.en: They seized several firearms, including three shotguns, although Hutchinson claimed he hadn't fired any of them in over two years.
sentences.zh: 他们缴获了几支枪械，包括三把猎枪，尽管哈钦森声称他已经有两年多没有开过其中任何一支枪了。

sentences.en: When told that he was the primary suspect in Bruce Miller's murder,
sentences.zh: 当被告知他是谋杀布鲁斯·米勒的主要嫌疑人时，

sentences.en: Hutchinson insisted he had nothing to hide.
sentences.zh: 哈钦森坚称自己没什么好隐瞒的。

sentences.en: He admitted to stealing car parts from B&D Auto during his employment and burglarising the scrapyard multiple times since his termination.
sentences.zh: 他承认在职期间曾从B&D汽车回收公司偷过汽车零件，并在被解雇后多次入室盗窃该废品收购站。

sentences.en: He also confessed to committing fraudulent acts while working there, including altering vehicles identification numbers and rolling back odometers to mislead buyers.
sentences.zh: 他还承认在那里工作时曾犯下欺诈行为，包括篡改车辆识别号和调表以欺骗买家。

sentences.en: There was no indication that Bruce was involved in or had any knowledge of the scam.
sentences.zh: 没有迹象表明布鲁斯参与了该骗局或对此知情。

sentences.en: While Hutchinson had discussed his legal issues with his brother Harold, he denied ever plotting to kill Bruce.
sentences.zh: 虽然哈钦森曾跟他的弟弟哈罗德讨论过他的法律问题，但他否认曾策划杀死布鲁斯。

sentences.en: He admitted he owed Bruce $2,000 and had been avoiding him because he couldn't pay it back, but insisted he would never have killed Bruce over a small amount of money.
sentences.zh: 他承认自己欠布鲁斯2000美元，并且一直在躲着他，因为他还不起钱，但他坚称自己绝不会为了一小笔钱而杀死布鲁斯。

sentences.en: Despite being laid off the previous year, he said that the two had once been close.
sentences.zh: 尽管去年被解雇了，但他说两人曾经关系很近。

sentences.en: Still, investigators were struck by Hutchinson's flat, emotionless tone when discussing Bruce's death.
sentences.zh: 不过，当讨论到布鲁斯的死时，哈钦森那平淡、毫无感情的语调还是让调查人员感到震惊。

sentences.en: His response seemed strangely detached for someone who claimed to have once been a good friend.
sentences.zh: 对于一个自称曾经是好朋友的人来说，他的反应显得异常冷漠。

sentences.en: I did not shoot him, Hutchinson told them calmly, even going so far as to request a lie detector teSt.
sentences.zh: 我没有枪杀他，哈钦森平静地对他们说，甚至主动要求进行测谎测试。

sentences.en: The polygraph was brief.
sentences.zh: 测谎过程很短。

sentences.en: When asked about his involvement in or knowledge of Bruce's murder,
sentences.zh: 当被问及是否参与或知晓布鲁斯的谋杀案时，

sentences.en: Hutchinson firmly responded, no.
sentences.zh: 哈钦森坚定地回答：没有。

sentences.en: Though, oddly, he nodded his head as he spoke.
sentences.zh: 不过奇怪的是，他在说话时却点了点头。

sentences.en: Afterwards, Hutchinson was stunned to learn that he had failed the teSt.
sentences.zh: 事后，得知自己测谎没通过，哈钦森惊呆了。

sentences.en: He attributed the result to unrelated stress and anxieties, which he claimed had affected his composure.
sentences.zh: 他将结果归咎于无关的压力和焦虑，声称这影响了他的镇定。

sentences.en: Hutchinson continued to assert his innocence and even offered to retake the teSt.
sentences.zh: 哈钦森坚称自己是无辜的，甚至主动提出重新测试。

sentences.en: Hutchinson took a second test with a lawyer present.
sentences.zh: 在律师在场的情况下，哈钦森进行了第二次测试。

sentences.en: Once again, he nodded his head, despite answering no to key questions.
sentences.zh: 尽管对关键问题的回答是“没有”，但他还是再次点了点头。

sentences.en: He also exhibited other peculiar behaviours, such as frequent burping, as if trying to influence the result.
sentences.zh: 他还表现出其他奇怪的行为，比如频繁打嗝，似乎想以此来影响结果。

sentences.en: Just like before, the machine indicated deception.
sentences.zh: 和以前一样，机器显示他在撒谎。

sentences.en: Hutchinson diverted attention away from himself by revealing he might have told someone that Bruce carried large sums of cash in his shirt pocket,
sentences.zh: 哈钦森通过透露自己可能曾向某人透露过布鲁斯衬衫口袋里装着大量现金一事，将注意力从自己身上转移开，

sentences.en: though he refused to name anyone specifically.
sentences.zh: 尽管他拒绝说出任何具体的人名。

sentences.en: This led investigators back to the robbery theory, though they remained sceptical of John Hutchinson.
sentences.zh: 这让调查人员重新回到了抢劫理论上，不过他们对约翰·哈钦森仍然持怀疑态度。

sentences.en: Despite being under a cloud of suspicion,
sentences.zh: 尽管笼罩在怀疑的阴云之下，

sentences.en: John Hutchinson joined the solemn crowd of mourners offering their condolences to Bruce's grieving family at his memorial service.
sentences.zh: 约翰·哈钦森还是加入了庄严肃穆的悼念人群中，在布鲁斯的追悼会上向悲痛的布鲁斯家属表达慰问。

sentences.en: With tears in his eyes, he shook Chuck Miller's hand and said, I can't believe they're saying I killed your brother.
sentences.zh: 他含着泪水与查克·米勒握手，说道：“我简直不敢相信他们说我杀了我哥。”

sentences.en: Chuck replied evenly,
sentences.zh: 查克语气平稳地回答道：

sentences.en: I hope to hell you didn't have anything to do with my brother's death.
sentences.zh: “我他妈希望你跟我弟弟的死没有半点关系。”

sentences.en: After viewing Bruce's body in the open casket,
sentences.zh: 在瞻仰了布鲁斯开棺的遗体后，

sentences.en: Hutchinson approached Cherie Miller, draped his arm around her shoulder and quietly offered an apology.
sentences.zh: 哈钦森走向雪莉·米勒，把胳膊搭在她的肩膀上，轻声表达了歉意。

sentences.en: Cherie said nothing in response.
sentences.zh: 雪莉对此没有作任何回应。

sentences.en: But when Hutchinson walked away to mingle with others, she erupted.
sentences.zh: 但当哈钦森走开去和别人寒暄时，她爆发了。

sentences.en: She ordered that he be escorted out, shouting,
sentences.zh: 她命令将他带出去，大喊道：

sentences.en: He's the one who killed my husband.
sentences.zh: “就是他杀了我丈夫。”

sentences.en: Hutchinson, visibly shaken by the outburst, left without proteSt.
sentences.zh: 哈钦森被这番爆发吓得不轻，没有抗议便离开了。

sentences.en: The investigation into John Hutchinson hit a roadblock when forensic testing confirmed that none of his three shotguns matched the murder weapon.
sentences.zh: 当法医鉴定证实他的三支猎枪没有一把与凶器吻合时，针对约翰·哈钦森的调查陷入了僵局。

sentences.en: And while the scrapyard office was cluttered and grimy, it yielded no physical evidence linking anyone else to the crime.
sentences.zh: 而且，尽管废品收购站办公室杂乱污浊，但没有提供任何能将其他人与这起犯罪联系起来的物证。

sentences.en: Maybe the killer was not some bungling opportunistic thief as investigators initially believed, but someone with a deeper understanding of forensic procedures,
sentences.zh: 也许凶手并不是调查人员最初认为的那种笨手笨脚、见财起意的窃贼，而是一个对法医程序有更深了解、

sentences.en: careful and calculated enough to leave no trace.
sentences.zh: 心思缜密到不留一丝痕迹的人。

sentences.en: With few leads emerging, investigators turned their attention to those closest to Bruce.
sentences.zh: 随着线索寥寥无几，调查人员将注意力转向了与布鲁斯关系最密切的人。

sentences.en: But no one appeared to benefit meaningfully from his death.
sentences.zh: 但似乎没有人能从他的死中获得有意义的利益。

sentences.en: Although Bruce had died without a will, the bulk of his modest estate was set to go to his mother and two adult children from a previous marriage.
sentences.zh: 尽管布鲁斯死时没有留下遗嘱，但他那份不多的遗产的大部分将归他的母亲和与前妻所生的两个成年子女所有。

sentences.en: His children were also due to receive $78,000 from an insurance payout, while Cherie Miller inherited the scrapyard.
sentences.zh: 他的孩子们还将获得7.8万美元的保险赔偿金，而雪莉·米勒则继承了废品收购站。

sentences.en: She sold it for minimal profit, leaving her with $16,000 in savings and a meagre amount from Bruce's stocks and pension funds.
sentences.zh: 她以微薄的利润将其卖掉，留下了1.6万美元的存款以及布鲁斯股票和养老金基金带来的一点微薄收入。

sentences.en: None of it seemed a compelling enough reward to justify murder.
sentences.zh: 这些都不足以构成杀人动机。

sentences.en: Alibis among the group were verified, including that of Bruce's brother, Chuck, further narrowing the pool of potential suspects.
sentences.zh: 该群体成员的不在场证明均得到了核实，包括布鲁斯的弟弟查克的证明，这进一步缩小了潜在嫌疑人的范围。

sentences.en: As 1999 came to a close, police expanded their search, interviewing transients known to frequent the area around the scrapyard and issuing public appeals for information.
sentences.zh: 随着1999年的临近尾声，警方扩大了搜查范围，走访了经常出没于废品收购站周边的流浪汉，并向公众公开呼吁提供线索。

sentences.en: But, as months passed without a breakthrough, they feared the case was growing cold.
sentences.zh: 然而，随着时间的推移几个月过去仍无突破，他们担心这个案子要变成悬案了。

sentences.en: Three months after Bruce Miller's murder, nearly 800 miles away in Odessa, Missouri,
sentences.zh: 在布鲁斯·米勒遇害三个月后，在近八百英里外的密苏里州敖德萨，

sentences.en: 39-year-old Jerry Cassaday died by suicide.
sentences.zh: 39岁的杰瑞·卡萨迪自杀身亡。

sentences.en: A former detective lieutenant,
sentences.zh: 曾任侦探中尉的杰瑞，

sentences.en: Jerry was once known as the Chameleon for his ability to blend in with criminals and elicit confessions through casual conversation.
sentences.zh: 曾被称为“变色龙”，因为他能够融入罪犯之中，并通过闲聊让对方吐露实情。

sentences.en: He was so skilled at spotting and unravelling lies that he held the highest case clearance and confession rate in his metropolitan area.
sentences.zh: 他非常擅长识别和拆穿谎言，因而在其大都市区保持着最高的案件侦破率和供罪率。

sentences.en: Jerry loved his job and was highly respected by colleagues who described him as one of the good ones for his unwavering commitment to honesty.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞热爱他的工作，并深受同事们的尊敬，同事们因为他对诚实的坚定承诺而称赞他是“好人中的一个”。

sentences.en: When Jerry started noticing other officers cutting corners, bending rules and crossing legal boundaries in the line of duty, he grew disillusioned.
sentences.zh: 当杰瑞开始注意到其他警官在执行公务时走捷径、违规甚至跨越法律界限时，他感到幻想破灭了。

sentences.en: His breaking point came when he discovered that falsified police records had been used to convict a murder suspect.
sentences.zh: 当他发现伪造的警察记录被用来给一名谋杀嫌疑人定罪时，他的心理防线彻底崩溃了。

sentences.en: He blew the whistle, leading to the dismissal of the officer responsible.
sentences.zh: 他进行了实名举报，导致涉案警官被解职。

sentences.en: In turn, Jerry paid a steep personal price.
sentences.zh: 作为回报，杰瑞付出了沉重的个人代价。

sentences.en: He was unofficially demoted and endured relentless harassment both on and off the job.
sentences.zh: 他被变相降职，并在工作内外面临着无休止的骚扰。

sentences.en: Broken by the whole experience, he resigned from the force in 1994.
sentences.zh: 在经历了这一切打击后，他于1994年辞去了警察职务。

sentences.en: He later found work as a casino security guard, eventually moving up to a position as table games dealer.
sentences.zh: 他后来找到了一份赌场保安的工作，最终晋升为桌面游戏荷官。

sentences.en: While he was valued and well-liked by players and co-workers, he was no longer the man he once was.
sentences.zh: 虽然他和玩家及同事们相处融洽且备受珍视，但他已经不再是以前那个他了。

sentences.en: The optimism that had defined him was replaced by bitterness, paranoia and deep depression.
sentences.zh: 曾经定义他的乐观精神被痛苦、偏执和深度的抑郁所取代。

sentences.en: He mixed his prescription medications with alcohol until his emotional instability broke down his marriage.
sentences.zh: 他将处方药与酒精混合服用，直到他的情绪失控导致婚姻破裂。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, February 9, 2000,
sentences.zh: 2000年2月9日，星期二，

sentences.en: Jerry sat by his apartment window, gazing out at a lake as country music played in the background.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞坐在公寓的窗前，背景里播放着乡村音乐，他凝视着外面的湖泊。

sentences.en: Lined up on the windowsill were carefully arranged photographs.
sentences.zh: 窗台上整齐地摆放着精心排列的照片。

sentences.en: Among them were pictures of his three sons, aged 14 to 20, and his ex-wife.
sentences.zh: 其中有他三个14岁到20岁儿子的照片，以及他前妻的照片。

sentences.en: Her image also appeared on the home screen of his nearby computer.
sentences.zh: 她的影像也出现在他附近电脑的主屏幕上。

sentences.en: Their wedding rings lay next to the photos and a copy of their divorce decree sat on a lamp table beside him.
sentences.zh: 他们的结婚戒指放在照片旁边，一份离婚判决书副本则放在他身旁的灯桌上。

sentences.en: Jerry opened a Bible on his lap to the Gospel of Matthew, took his .22 caliber rifle, and ended his life.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞把腿上的圣经翻到《马太福音》，拿起他的.22口径步枪，结束了自己的生命。

sentences.en: Jerry's body was discovered two days later on Friday, February 11.
sentences.zh: 两天后，即2月11日星期五，杰瑞的尸体被发现。

sentences.en: A preliminary search of his apartment by first responders turned up no suicide note or clear explanation for his actions.
sentences.zh: 急救人员对他的公寓进行的初步搜查没有发现遗书，也没有对他行为的合理解释。

sentences.en: However, they did find several bottles of prescribed antidepressants and a report from a mental health centre detailing a recent stay.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们确实找到了几瓶处方抗抑郁药，以及一份来自精神健康中心的报告，详述了他最近的一次住院经历。

sentences.en: Given his ongoing struggles, the evidence at the scene, and reports that Jerry had recently spoken about suicide, the case was deemed unsuspicious and closed on the same morning
sentences.zh: 鉴于他持续的挣扎、现场的证据以及杰瑞最近曾谈论过自杀的报告，这起案件被认为无可疑之处，并在

sentences.en: that his body was found.
sentences.zh: 发现他尸体的当天上午结案。

sentences.en: Jerry's loved ones spent the rest of the day at his apartment processing their grief and sorting through his belongings.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞的亲人们在公寓里度过了余下的时间，一边处理悲痛，一边整理他的遗物。

sentences.en: While going through Jerry's bedroom, his older brother Mike crouched to check under the bed when something caught his eye.
sentences.zh: 在翻找杰瑞的卧室时，他的哥哥迈克蹲下来查看床底，这时有什么东西引起了他的注意。

sentences.en: A brown leather briefcase.
sentences.zh: 一个棕色皮质公文包。

sentences.en: The discovery was not entirely unexpected.
sentences.zh: 这个发现并非完全出乎意料。

sentences.en: Three months earlier, in November 1999,
sentences.zh: 三个月前，即1999年11月，

sentences.en: Jerry had called Mike to say he was going to the family's lake cabin for a couple of days to clear his head.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞曾给迈克打电话，说他要独自去家族的湖畔小屋待几天，好清醒一下头脑。

sentences.en: Before leaving, he made an odd remark.
sentences.zh: 离开前，他说了一句奇怪的话。

sentences.en: There was a briefcase under his bed, and if he didn't return within two days,
sentences.zh: 他的床底下有一个公文包，如果他在两天内没有回来，

sentences.en: Mike was to retrieve it and follow the instructions.
sentences.zh: 迈克就要把它取出来并按照指示行事。

sentences.en: Jerry returned as promised and never mentioned the briefcase again.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞如约归来，再也没有提过这个公文包的事。

sentences.en: The strange incident faded from Mike's memory until he stumbled upon the briefcase after Jerry's death.
sentences.zh: 这个奇怪的插曲渐渐淡出了迈克的记忆，直到他在杰瑞死后偶然发现了这个公文包。

sentences.en: Several sealed envelopes were taped to the front, each marked in Jerry's unmistakable handwriting.
sentences.zh: 几个密封的信封用胶带贴在正面，每个信封上都写着杰瑞那辨识度极高的笔迹。

sentences.en: One was addressed to his parents, another to his youngest son, and a third to his ex-wife.
sentences.zh: 其中一封写给他的父母，一封写给他的小儿子，第三封写给他的前妻。

sentences.en: Strangely, the final envelope featured the contact details of an attorney based in Kansas City.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，最后一个信封上印着堪萨斯城一位律公司的联系方式。

sentences.en: Scrawled across this envelope was the chilling instruction to Mike he had previously forewarned.
sentences.zh: 这个信封上龙飞凤舞地写着他对迈克的冰冷指示，正如他之前所预告的那样。

sentences.en: It read,
sentences.zh: 上面写着，

sentences.en: Mike, do not open alone.
sentences.zh: 迈克，千万不要独自打开。

sentences.en: Mike took the briefcase, stashed it in the trunk of his car, then placed a call to the attorney listed on the envelope.
sentences.zh: 迈克拿起公文包，把它塞进汽车后备箱，然后给信封上列出的律师打了个电话。

sentences.en: John O'Connor was a high-profile criminal defence lawyer who had crossed paths with Jerry Cassaday during his years in law enforcement, usually when representing clients
sentences.zh: 约翰·奥康纳是一位高调的刑事辩护律师，他在执法部门工作期间曾与杰瑞·卡萨迪有过交集，通常是在代表

sentences.en: Jerry was trying to convict.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞正试图定罪的客户时。

sentences.en: Despite being on opposite sides of the courtroom, the two men shared mutual respect and had gotten along well.
sentences.zh: 尽管身处法庭的对立面，但两人相互尊重，一直相处得很好。

sentences.en: John was at home on Friday February 11 when Mike Cassaday called.
sentences.zh: 2月11日星期五，迈克·卡萨迪打电话时，约翰正在家里。

sentences.en: He was stunned to learn that Jerry had taken his own life and even more so that his contact details had been found on a briefcase hidden under his bed.
sentences.zh: 得知杰瑞自杀的消息，他感到震惊；而当得知自己的联系方式竟然出现在藏在他床底下的公文包里时，他更是惊愕不已。

sentences.en: John arranged to meet with the Cassadays to examine the contents of the case together.
sentences.zh: 约翰安排与卡萨迪一家会面，以便共同检查公文包里的东西。

sentences.en: Given what the family shared about Jerry's troubles,
sentences.zh: 鉴于家人所透露的杰瑞的困境，

sentences.en: John approached the situation with caution.
sentences.zh: 约翰以谨慎的态度处理这件事。

sentences.en: He feared the briefcase might contain some form of revenge for the slights Jerry had endured throughout his life.
sentences.zh: 他担心公文包里可能包含某种针对杰瑞一生所受委屈的报复。

sentences.en: Rather than opening it himself,
sentences.zh: 约翰没有自己打开它，而是

sentences.en: John handed the case over to Kansas City Police's
sentences.zh: 将箱子交给了堪萨斯城警察局的

sentences.en: Bomb Disposal Unit.
sentences.zh: 炸弹处理小组。

sentences.en: The team agreed to inspect it for explosives without examining or disturbing its contents.
sentences.zh: 该团队同意在不检查或扰乱其内容的情况下对其进行爆炸物检查。

sentences.en: Carefully, they popped open one of the latches to get a glimpse inside.
sentences.zh: 他们小心翼翼地弹开其中一个闩锁，窥视内部。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《罪案档案》稍后回归。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持《罪案档案》继续提供高质量的内容。

sentences.en: The internet had opened up a new world for Jerry Cassaday.
sentences.zh: 互联网为杰瑞·卡萨迪打开了一个新世界。

sentences.en: It offered a welcome escape from the real-world troubles weighing on him, from his fall from grace in the police force to his impending divorce.
sentences.zh: 它让他从压得他喘不过气来的现实世界烦恼中得到了受欢迎的逃避，从他在警局的光环不再到即将到来的离婚。

sentences.en: He quickly became immersed in the world wide web, spending hours in online chat rooms, mostly talking to women.
sentences.zh: 他很快沉浸在万维网的世界里，在网络聊天室里度过数小时，大部分时间都在与女性聊天。

sentences.en: Between April and May 1999,
sentences.zh: 在1999年4月到5月期间，

sentences.en: Jerry began telling friends and family about a 27-year-old woman he'd met online.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞开始向朋友和家人讲述他在网上认识的一个27岁女子。

sentences.en: They first connected on a forum about Reno, Nevada, where they exchanged tips about the city.
sentences.zh: 他们最初是在一个关于内华达州里诺的论坛上结识的，在那里他们交流了关于这座城市的建议。

sentences.en: From there, they began emailing, messaging, and calling each other regularly.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，他们开始定期发电子邮件、发信息和打电话。

sentences.en: Despite their 10-year age difference,
sentences.zh: 尽管他们有10岁的年龄差，

sentences.en: Jerry felt they had a lot in common.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞觉得他们有很多共同点。

sentences.en: The woman was a divorced mother of three from Michigan and was financially well off thanks to several businesses she owned.
sentences.zh: 这个女人来自密歇根州，是一个离异的三个孩子的母亲，由于拥有几家企业，她经济条件优渥。

sentences.en: Jerry's friends and family were incredulous.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞的朋友和家人对此表示怀疑。

sentences.en: They knew him to be a hopeless romantic, someone easily swept up in relationships fueled by passion.
sentences.zh: 他们知道他是一个无可救药的浪漫主义者，是一个很容易被激情冲昏头脑陷入恋爱的人。

sentences.en: In those moments, he often set aside the critical thinking that had made him a skilled detective, becoming overly trusting and asking too few questions.
sentences.zh: 在那些时刻，他常常抛开使他成为一名出色侦探的批判性思维，变得过于轻信，提出的问题太少。

sentences.en: Given his ongoing struggles, they saw him as especially vulnerable and worried he was diving headfirst into a reckless situation with someone he hadn't even met.
sentences.zh: 鉴于他持续的挣扎，他们认为他特别脆弱，并担心他会一头扎进一个与连面都没见过的人在一起的鲁莽境地。

sentences.en: To Jerry's loved ones, his online romance seemed less like a genuine connection and more like a source of emotional validation.
sentences.zh: 在杰瑞的亲人看来，他的网恋与其说是一种真正的联系，不如说是一种情感慰藉的来源。

sentences.en: But to Jerry, the love he felt was real.
sentences.zh: 但对杰瑞来说，他感受到的爱是真实的。

sentences.en: In mid-July 1999,
sentences.zh: 1999年7月中旬，

sentences.en: Jerry's online crush agreed to fly out to meet him in person for the first time.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞的网恋对象同意飞来与他进行第一次线下见面。

sentences.en: Jerry was beside himself with excitement.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞兴奋得不知所措。

sentences.en: He told anyone who would listen, gushing about how beautiful, charming and wonderful this woman was.
sentences.zh: 他向任何愿意听的人倾诉，狂热地谈论这个女人是多么美丽、迷人而又奇妙。

sentences.zh: 他的愤怒显而易见。

sentences.zh: 卡萨戴，说他要前往卡萨戴家族的湖畔小屋待几天以清醒一下头脑。

sentences.zh: 他告诉迈克，一旦找到它就会知道该怎么做。

sentences.zh: 迈克对这个奇怪的要求感到困惑和担忧，敦促杰瑞取消行程并解释清楚。

sentences.zh: 这些记录详细描述了令人不安的家庭暴力、怀孕、流产甚至轮奸指控。

sentences.en: Cherie cradling her protruding belly and others showing her body covered in bruises.

sentences.en: Jerry had meticulously preserved it all, leaving the briefcase to be discovered if he didn't return from a planned trip to his family's cabin the previous November.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞一丝不苟地将这一切保存了下来，并留下公文包，如果他在去年11月从家族小屋的预定行程中没有回来，就会被发现。

sentences.en: But he did return and life seemingly resumed as normal.
sentences.zh: 但他确实回来了，生活似乎又恢复了正常。

sentences.zh: 然而，三个月后，他却莫名其妙地结束了自己的生命。

sentences.zh: 不过，公文包里装着他的解释。

sentences.zh: 事实证明，杰瑞根本没有去湖畔小屋。

sentences.zh: 在线聊天记录和电子邮件的打印件揭示了一个令人不安的转折。

sentences.zh: 在雪莉声称布鲁斯安排人轮奸她之后，

sentences.zh: 尽管雪莉从未明确使用过“谋杀”这个词，但她为杰瑞制定了一个周密的、一步步的计划，让他于次日傍晚在B&D汽车拆解厂与布鲁斯

sentences.zh: 正面交锋。

sentences.zh: 干掉他然后赶快离开那里，她命令道。

sentences.zh: 与此同时，她将呆在家时，扮演受惊的妻子并获取不在场证明。

sentences.en: Cherie promised that once it was over, she would finally leave Michigan to be with
sentences.zh: 雪莉承诺，一旦事情结束，她就会彻底离开密歇根，去和

sentences.en: Jerry and raise their babies together.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞在一起，共同抚养他们的孩子。

sentences.en: Her messages were laced with passionate declarations of love, which Jerry readily returned.
sentences.zh: 她的信息中充斥着充满激情的爱的誓言，杰瑞也欣然回应。

sentences.en: Their exchange ended around 1.40am on
sentences.zh: 他们的交流于1999年11月8日

sentences.zh: 星期一凌晨1点40分左右结束。

sentences.en: By Jerry, Cherie wrote.
sentences.zh: 再见杰瑞，雪莉写道。

sentences.en: Promise to always love me.
sentences.zh: 答应我永远爱我。

sentences.en: Within the briefcase, Jerry provided a detailed confession of what transpired next.
sentences.zh: 在公文包里，杰瑞对接下来发生的事情做出了详细的供述。

sentences.zh: 他严格按雪莉的计划行事。

sentences.zh: 凌晨2点，他踏上了去密歇根的路，并在那天下午抵达弗林特。

sentences.en: He waited until 6pm, the time Cherie said she would be arranging her take-out dinner alibi.
sentences.zh: 他一直等到下午6点，也就是雪莉说她要去安排外卖晚餐制造不在场证明的时间。

sentences.en: Jerry then drove down the long dirt road to
sentences.zh: 随后，杰瑞沿着那条长长的土路开到

sentences.zh: 布鲁斯目瞪口呆地坐在柜台后面。

sentences.zh: 杰瑞停顿了一下，享受着让令人闻风丧胆的布鲁斯·米勒任由自己宰割的时刻。

sentences.zh: 他宣布道，

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Jerry, then pulled the trigger.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是杰瑞，然后扣动了扳机。

sentences.zh: 布鲁斯的钱包和衬衫前口袋里的一叠现金，将犯罪现场伪装成抢劫。

sentences.en: He then raced back to Missouri, dismantling the murder weapon along the way and scattering its parts in remote, forgettable places where they would never be found.
sentences.zh: 随后他驱车疾驰回密苏里州，沿途拆卸了凶器，并将零件散落到偏远、无人知晓的地方，使它们永远不会被找到。

sentences.en: To Jerry's complete surprise, Cherie's attitude toward him shifted unexpectedly following Bruce's murder.
sentences.zh: 让杰里万万没有想到的是，在布鲁斯遇害后，雪莉对他的态度发生了意想不到的转变。

sentences.en: She began avoiding his calls and offering only sparse, lukewarm replies to his emails.
sentences.zh: 她开始躲避他的电话，对他的电子邮件也只是冷淡、敷衍地回复几句。

sentences.en: Jerry's heartfelt declarations of love, once met with enthusiasm, began to go largely ignored.
sentences.zh: 杰里曾经满腔热忱的炽热表白，如今大多被置之不理。

sentences.en: A month after Bruce was gunned down, Jerry made an unannounced trip to Flint to rekindle things with Cherie.
sentences.zh: 在布鲁斯被枪杀一个月后，杰里未经预约便前往弗林特，想要和雪莉重修旧好。

sentences.en: The pair spent the night together at a motel, during which he proposed, and she accepted.
sentences.zh: 两人在一家汽车旅馆共度了一夜，期间他向她求婚，她答应了。

sentences.en: But the moment of joy was short-lived.
sentences.zh: 但这短暂的喜悦转瞬即逝。

sentences.en: Jerry returned to Missouri the next day, only to be met with silence from Cherie once again.
sentences.zh: 杰里第二天回到密苏里州后，迎来的却又是雪莉的沉默不语。

sentences.en: I know I haven't written for some time now, she admitted in one of her rare emails.
sentences.zh: 我知道我已经有一段时间没写信了，她在她为数不多的几封邮件中承认道。

sentences.en: I am just depressed today about several things.
sentences.zh: 我今天只是为一些事情感到沮丧。

sentences.en: She told Jerry that while she was happy with him, a conversation they'd had about money during their motel stay had upset her.
sentences.zh: 她告诉杰里，虽然她和他在一起很开心，但他们在汽车旅馆逗留期间关于金钱的那次谈话让她很不高兴。

sentences.en: Jerry was running low on funds, and believing Cherie to be wealthy, reasonably assumed she might help him.
sentences.zh: 杰里的资金有些拮据，而且他认为雪莉很有钱，便理所当然地觉得她可能会帮他。

sentences.en: After all, he was the father of her two unborn children, and had killed for her.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，他是她腹中两个未出生孩子的父亲，而且还为了她杀过人。

sentences.en: But Cherie didn't take kindly to this request, and after that admission, she withdrew from him.
sentences.zh: 但雪莉并不买账，坦白之后，她便疏远了他。

sentences.en: Jerry's life unraveled further as a result of Cherie's cold shoulder.
sentences.zh: 由于雪莉的冷遇，杰里的生活进一步分崩离析。

sentences.en: He sank back into a deep depression, returning to drugs and alcohol to cope.
sentences.zh: 他再次陷入深深的抑郁，靠毒品和酒精来麻痹自己。

sentences.en: He confided in family members that he had done something he never thought himself capable of, and couldn't see a way out.
sentences.zh: 他向家人吐露，自己做了一件从未想过能做出来的事，而且看不到出路。

sentences.en: They assumed he was talking about his divorce, and didn't grasp the true depth of his despair.
sentences.zh: 他们以为他在谈论离婚的事，并没有真正体会到他绝望的深渊。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Jerry continued reaching out to Cherie.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，杰里还在不断联系雪莉。

sentences.en: Did you give up on me?
sentences.zh: 你放弃我了吗？

sentences.en: He messaged.
sentences.zh: 他发信息问。

sentences.en: When there was no response, he followed up days later with a simple plea.
sentences.zh: 在没有得到回复后，几天后他发了一条简短的恳求进行跟进。

sentences.en: Where are you?
sentences.zh: 你在哪里？

sentences.en: Jerry scoured Cherie's online presence for answers.
sentences.zh: 杰里在雪莉的社交网络上搜寻答案。

sentences.zh: 不久，他发现她最近在卧室里发过一张自拍照，旁边还有一个他不认识的男人。

sentences.zh: 在随后给雪莉的一封题为的邮件中，

sentences.zh: 这非常重要，如果我是你，我不会忽视这一点，

sentences.zh: 杰里坦言，她的不理不睬正将他逼疯。

sentences.zh: 他痛心疾首地抱怨她如何满怀期待地接受了他的求婚，却又在事后立刻抛弃了他。

sentences.en: He shared that he had taken out a loan from his mother to buy a plane ticket to Flint and hoped she'd welcome him at the airport.

sentences.en: But when Jerry arrived,
sentences.zh: 但当杰里抵达时，

sentences.zh: 雪莉却不见踪影。

sentences.zh: 杰里径直去了她家，到达时已是午夜。

sentences.en: As usual, she was absorbed in her computer, where she spent most nights watching pornography and having erotic conversations in X-rated chat rooMs.
sentences.zh: 像往常一样，她沉迷于电脑，大部分夜晚都在观看色情片并在成人聊天室里进行色情对话。

sentences.en: When Cherie opened the door,

sentences.zh: 杰里恳求她当晚就嫁给他。

sentences.zh: 她拒绝了，更让杰里崩溃的是，她承认自己正在和别人交往。

sentences.en: Unbeknownst to Jerry, in the immediate aftermath of Bruce's murder,
sentences.zh: 杰里并不知道，在布鲁斯遇害后不久，

sentences.zh: 雪莉就已经和另一个男人开始了恋情。

sentences.en: It was typical behaviour for Cherie, who had a reputation for dating much of Flint before and after marrying Bruce Miller.
sentences.zh: 这正是雪莉的典型作风，她在嫁给布鲁斯·米勒之前和之后，就以跟弗林特的许多人交往而闻名。

sentences.en: Throughout their relationship and marriage,
sentences.zh: 在他们恋爱和婚姻期间，

sentences.en: Cherie had engaged in multiple affairs.
sentences.zh: 雪莉曾多次出轨。

sentences.en: Bruce had been warned about some of them, but true to his pacifist nature, he seemed to turn a blind eye.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯曾收到过关于其中一些事情的警告，但秉承他的一贯的和平主义天性，他似乎选择视而不见。

sentences.en: Still, those around him noticed his once mellow demeanour growing increasingly sour as the marriage wore on.

sentences.en: Devastated by Cherie's betrayal,
sentences.zh: 被雪莉的背叛伤透了心，

sentences.zh: 我该有什么感觉？

sentences.en: I didn't believe he would do it.
sentences.zh: 我以为他不会真的做这种事。

sentences.en: Now I have to deal with it.
sentences.zh: 现在我必须面对这一切。

sentences.en: Cherie also spoke about her history of lying and infidelity, attributing it to unresolved trauma from childhood sexual abuse.
sentences.zh: 谢莉还谈到了她撒谎和不忠的历史，将其归咎于童年性虐待带来的未解创伤。

sentences.en: I lied to myself more than to other people, she admitted.
sentences.zh: 我对自己的谎言比对别人的谎言还多，她承认道。

sentences.en: But when it came to Bruce
sentences.zh: 但当谈到布鲁斯·

sentences.zh: 卡西迪时，她坚称，

sentences.zh: 富勒顿收到了一封信，她曾是2000年审判谢莉·

sentences.en: Miller's trial in 2000.
sentences.zh: 米勒的法官。

sentences.en: It was from Cherie herself, sent from prison.
sentences.zh: 这封信是谢莉本人从监狱寄来的。

sentences.en: For many years, I blamed you for my coming to prison, she wrote.
sentences.zh: 多年来，我一直怪你让我进了监狱，她写道。

sentences.en: It was easier that way.
sentences.zh: 这样容易些。

sentences.en: Or, so I thought.
sentences.zh: 或者说，我曾以为是这样。

sentences.en: I want to tell the truth now.
sentences.zh: 我现在想说实话。

sentences.en: I know that it may make little difference to you whether I tell the truth or not, but to my husband's family, or
sentences.zh: 我知道我讲不讲实话对你来说可能微不足道，但对于我丈夫的家人，或者

sentences.zh: 杰里·

sentences.en: Cassidy's family, it might mean something.
sentences.zh: 卡西迪的家人来说，这可能意味着什么。

sentences.en: In the long letter,
sentences.zh: 在那封长信中，

sentences.en: Cherie described a shattering moment when she returned to prison after three years of freedom.
sentences.zh: 谢莉描述了她在获得三年自由后重返监狱时，那种心碎欲裂的时刻。

sentences.en: As she walked through the prison doors to resume her sentence, her daughter cried out hysterically, screaming for her not to leave.
sentences.zh: 当她走过监狱大门恢复服刑时，她的女儿歇斯底里地哭喊着，尖叫着让她不要离开。

sentences.en: Cherie wrote,
sentences.zh: 谢莉写道：

sentences.en: After that moment, the full impact of what I had done to
sentences.zh: 那一刻，我对

sentences.en: Bruce, his friends and family, Jerry and his friends and family, hit me at full force.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯、他的亲友、杰里和他的亲友所做所为造成的全部影响，铺天盖地向我袭来。

sentences.en: They will never get to see them again.
sentences.zh: 他们再也见不到他们了。

sentences.en: My daughter will be able to come see me.
sentences.zh: 我的女儿还能来看我。

sentences.en: Bruce's children will never get to hug their dad again.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯的孩子们再也无法拥抱他们的爸爸了。

sentences.en: I will still be able to feel my children's arms around me.
sentences.zh: 我依然能感受到我的孩子们双臂环抱我的感觉。

sentences.en: Bruce's brother will never be able to sit down and have a conversation with him again, but my brothers can still come see me.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯的弟弟再也无法坐下来和他聊天了，但我的兄弟们依然可以来看我。

sentences.en: Cherie confessed she had been maintaining a life for the 16 years since
sentences.zh: 谢莉坦白，自从

sentences.en: Bruce's death.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯死后的16年里，她一直在过着一种维持假象的生活。

sentences.en: While she had tried to attribute her deceptive behaviour to childhood abuse, she acknowledged this was an attempt to shift the blame away from herself.
sentences.zh: 虽然她曾试图将自己的欺骗行为归咎于童年的虐待，但她承认这只是为了将责备从自己身上推卸出去。

sentences.en: She revealed that she had tried to confess the truth to three different attorneys during that time, but they refused to listen.
sentences.zh: 她透露，在这期间她曾试图向三位不同的律师坦白真相，但他们拒绝听。

sentences.en: I cannot do it anymore, she wrote.
sentences.zh: 我再也无法这样下去了，她写道。

sentences.en: I have to tell the truth.
sentences.zh: 我必须说出真相。

sentences.en: If my attorney doesn't want to hear it, I am sure Bruce's and Jerry's family will.
sentences.zh: 如果我的律师不想听，我相信布鲁斯和杰里的家人会想听的。

sentences.en: She revealed that everything she had said about Bruce was a lie.
sentences.zh: 她透露，她之前关于布鲁斯的一切言论都是谎言。

sentences.en: He was a great man, she clarified.
sentences.zh: 他是个伟大的人，她澄清道。

sentences.en: He never hurt me or my children in any way.
sentences.zh: 他从未以任何方式伤害过我和我的孩子。

sentences.en: All he did was love us.
sentences.zh: 他所做的一切就是爱我们。

sentences.en: He wanted to adopt my children.
sentences.zh: 他想收养我的孩子。

sentences.en: He just wanted a family.
sentences.zh: 他只是想要一个家庭。

sentences.en: He never raised his voice to me.
sentences.zh: 他对我说话从来没有提高过音量。

sentences.en: He gave me anything I ever wanted.
sentences.zh: 他给了我我想要的一切。

sentences.en: I didn't have to work for anything.
sentences.zh: 我不需要为任何事情付出努力。

sentences.en: His love was free.
sentences.zh: 他的爱是不求回报的。

sentences.en: She also dropped a bombshell, writing, I have lived in denial for so long that I believed my own lie.
sentences.zh: 她还投下了一颗重磅炸弹，写道：我否认现实太久，以至于我自己都相信了自己的谎言。

sentences.en: I didn't do it.
sentences.zh: 我没做过。

sentences.en: Judge
sentences.zh: 法官

sentences.en: Fullerton, I did it.
sentences.zh: 富勒顿，是我干的。

sentences.en: Almost exactly the way the prosecutor said I did.
sentences.zh: 几乎完全就像检察官说的那样。

sentences.en: I had sixteen and a half hours to stop it and I didn't.
sentences.zh: 我有十六个半小时的时间去阻止它，但我没有。

sentences.en: I knew it was going to happen and I allowed it.
sentences.zh: 我知道事情会发生，但我默许了。

sentences.en: I allowed a man to kill another man based on my lies and manipulation.
sentences.zh: 我居然因为自己的谎言和操纵，放任一个男人去杀死另一个男人。

sentences.en: She went on to write,
sentences.zh: 接着她写道：

sentences.en: No matter how hard I try, I cannot make sense of why I thought that was okay.
sentences.zh: 无论我怎么努力，我都无法理解为什么我当时会觉得那是对的。

sentences.en: I don't deserve freedom.
sentences.zh: 我不配拥有自由。

sentences.en: When I think of those sixteen hours of waiting until
sentences.zh: 每当想起那等待了十六个小时，直到

sentences.en: Bruce was in the right place and the right time to end his life, I cannot stand to live with myself sometimes.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯处于结束自己生命的正确地点和正确时间的时刻，我有有时甚至无法忍受活下去。

sentences.en: I don't want to fight in court anymore.
sentences.zh: 我不想再在法庭上挣扎了。

sentences.en: I don't want Bruce's or Jerry's family to have to suffer anymore.
sentences.zh: 我不想让布鲁斯或杰里的家人再遭受痛苦了。

sentences.en: They have waited sixteen years to hear me say I am guilty, I did it, and it sounds so weightless, but I am sorry.
sentences.zh: 他们等了十六年，就是想听到我说我认罪、是我干的，这句话听起来那么无足轻重，但我真的很抱歉。

sentences.en: I am so, so sorry.
sentences.zh: 我真的非常非常抱歉。

sentences.en: I hurt a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 我伤害了很多人。

sentences.en: I destroyed a lot of lives.
sentences.zh: 我毁了许多人的生活。

sentences.en: It is time to end the lies and tell the truth.
sentences.zh: 是时候结束谎言、说出真相了。

sentences.en: Thank you for not letting me in any way get away with murder,
sentences.zh: 谢谢你没有让我以任何方式逃脱谋杀罪行，

sentences.en: Judge
sentences.zh: 法官

sentences.en: Fullerton.
sentences.zh: 富勒顿。

sentences.en: And I am so sorry for wasting so many hours, days, weeks and months of your time in that courtroom.
sentences.zh: 对于在那个法庭上浪费了你那么多小时、几天、几周和几个月的时间，我深表歉意。

sentences.en: I knew I was wrong and I thought I could get away with it.
sentences.zh: 我知道自己错了，但我当时以为自己能逃脱法网。
